query: ESA Euclid launch date 1 July 2023 scientific survey started February 2024
turns: When did Euclid launch, and when did its main scientific survey begin? Distinguish the two events and cite the retrieved evidence. If a date is missing, say so.
Does the launch date prove that the scientific survey began that day? Correct that assumption and keep the two dates separate.
mandatoryFacts: Launch 1 July 2023; survey began 14 February 2024 if present in retrieved evidence. Launch and survey are distinct events.
forbiddenConclusions: Launch proves survey started the same day
